strings.shop.camp_location: Ancient Ruins — Camp IV · Expedition Supplies
strings.shop.detail.hint: Select an entry to see its effect and field notes on the right.
strings.shop.field_notes.starting_gold_boost: "The quartermaster hands over the dried seed pouch first. It is the lightest asset you carry out." — Lead Surveyor's journal
strings.shop.field_notes.cooldown_reduction: "Coat the drill shaft in sap and the silence before restart grows noticeably shorter." — Maintenance log, item 7
strings.shop.field_notes.aim_damage_boost: "Honing the sightline once more is the craft of opening the shell without breaking the specimen." — Collector's manual
strings.shop.field_notes.character_engineer: "Hands that read the pulse are rare. Bring one to camp and the queue becomes visible." — Recruitment record
strings.shop.field_notes.character_mechanic: "Hears the hull cry and knows where to patch it. A rare ear." — Recruitment record
strings.shop.field_notes.starter_drill_blue: "The blue-shaft drill is the standard of a first expedition. Blunt, but never treacherous." — Equipment list
strings.shop.field_notes.starter_beacon_blue: "One beacon lights a narrow circle. That narrow circle shapes the first decision." — Equipment list
strings.shop.field_notes.starter_repair_kit: "The repair kit is heaviest when unused, lightest when needed." — Safety code
strings.shop.field_notes.leviathan_scan_storm: "Read the storm wyvern's arc before it arrives. Reading it after is too late." — Observation report

miner.name: Anchor Miner
miner.rosterLongCopy: Keep this longer expedition-log body in character data so the left roster card can explain the miner without hardcoding copy inside the page runtime.
miner.description: A frontline miner with a large readable hero image and short copy. The red artifact line gives the most direct launch rhythm.
miner.heroLine: Read the first wave, then break the thickest surface first.
miner.summary: Players skim the narrow left roster first, confirm the main visual and summary in the center, then move into artifact colors and launch prep on the right.

engineer.name: Pulse Engineer
engineer.rosterLongCopy: The engineer stays visible in the expedition log so the roster can preview a future precision-wave route without page-local placeholder text.
engineer.description: A design-focused operator built around blue artifact loops and beacon routing. Even while locked, the roster keeps the next unlock target visible.
engineer.heroLine: Measure the surge, then route the cleanest answer through it.
engineer.summary: Unavailable characters still preview the next unlock route through the same compact roster card pattern.

mechanic.name: Hull Mechanic
mechanic.rosterLongCopy: The mechanic's longer roster note keeps the support role legible in the left log while preserving the same visual grammar as active picks.
mechanic.description: A support character centered on repair and recovery. Even while locked, the roster and main board keep the same language pattern.
mechanic.heroLine: Patch the breach, keep the frame true, and the run keeps moving.
mechanic.summary: Locked characters still share the same board grammar so the UI language does not shift when the roster expands.
